description: Inbox byte or record budget is exhausted.

expected_upstream.notes: No equivalent. Upstream has no admission budget.

expected_holocron.notes: 429 with Retry-After (docs/decisions/0005, backpressure and lost client events). The unchanged tracker and recorder never retry, so the event is lost on the client; refusals count in refused_backpressure{route, reason} and show as lost client events. Retry-After helps only server integrations. One such refusal during the agreed 500 events/s burst fails the capacity gate.

validation_reason: Holocron-only behaviour. No upstream equivalent to compare.
